description.text: Teaching Objective To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability 1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine 2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; 3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; 4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; 5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research.Main coursesBiochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medical functional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology, oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine.Degree AwardedBachelor of Medicine

duration.text: The Stomatology at Zhengzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 625 USD/per year ￥ 4500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5. Certificate of English proficiency test6.0 or above for IELTS; 80 or above for TOEFL;or other certificates which can prove that the applicant is a native English speaker or English is his/her working language at college.6. certification of no criminal record

requirements.text: 1. Applicant should be non-Chinese citizen, healthy, without any crime records, aged less than 40 years old; with excellent academic record of master, and potentially to be a highly specialized researcher, engineer or professional; rich in publication. 2. Chinese Language requirements: Applicants who apply for CMI (Chinese Mediated Instruction) Science and /or Engineering programs should pass the level 5 HSK or above. Applicants with lower level HSK can first apply for Chinese Language Programs for a full year or half year in ZZU before their major studies. 3. Specific requirements for individual academic schools maybe imposed by the board and subjects taken. You are advised to check with your prospective school or supervisor. 4. For Research Degree Programs Since the postgraduate research degrees are individually supervised. We strongly recommend that prospective applicants make initial enquiries with the potential supervisor or school before submitting a formal application. A research proposal is required along with your formal application.
